Hi Evan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we have alignment:

— Highlights from call: demo of Redwood inference latency/cost controls, routing and model-mix recommendations, and the RBAC/KMS items you flagged.
— Action items for Acme: provide expected token volumes (monthly) and per-model mix (chat vs embeddings vs rerank), and an ideal target $/1M tokens or budget range.
— Action items for Redwood: produce a model-mix pricing estimate and sample unit economics (per-1M tokens) for your volumes, plus an initial SOW template if procurement requests it.

To make the pricing estimate actionable we need: monthly token volume (or alt: messages/day * avg tokens), expected split between chat (LLM generation), embeddings, and any rerank/semantic search calls, and any compliance/SLA constraints. If you have a budget range for the project (monthly or annual committed spend), include that too — it helps us recommend Dedicated vs Hosted.

Example: if you expect ~10M tokens/month with 80% chat / 15% embeddings / 5% rerank and a target unit cost of ~$10/1M tokens, we can show a few configurations (hosted vs reserved capacity) and the tradeoffs.

I’ve attached a quick pricing template you can populate; happy to take a call to walk through it. Proposed next step: you fill the template and we regroup early next week.

Thanks,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Pricing + model mix follow-up (post-demo)

Appreciate the numbers, Evan — this is exactly what we need. A few clarifications and initial unit-econ notes below:

1) Embeddings pricing: we price embeddings per 1M input tokens for transform-based embedding generation, and for vector storage/queries we surface separate rates (or bundle in Dedicated). For your 1536-d vectors we typically estimate token cost for generation + a small storage/query unit. I’ll put a detailed line item in the attached estimate.

2) Model mix math (using your 25M tokens/month):
   - Chat (generation): 19.5M tokens/month
   - Embeddings: 4.25M tokens/month
   - Rerank/semantic calls: 1.25M tokens/month

3) Example unit economics (ballpark; per 1M tokens):
   - Chat (conversational LLM optimized): base hosted rate $12/1M tokens; Dedicated reserved pricing can get to $4–6/1M depending on commit and sustained usage.
   - Embeddings: hosted $25/1M tokens (includes vector generation); Dedicated or pre-batched options reduce effective cost to $8–12/1M for high volumes.
   - Rerank (short sequences, CPU-friendly): hosted $8/1M tokens; Dedicated $2–4/1M.

Using a blended hosted example (no commitment) based on your mix: (19.5*$12 + 4.25*$25 + 1.25*$8) / 25 ≈ $13.4 per 1M tokens effective => ≈ $335/month for 25M tokens (hosted). That's rough — embeddings drive the skew.

If your target is ~$3k–6k/month for pilot, that maps to 225M–450M effective tokens at the $13.4/1M blended hosted price, or with a Dedicated commit we can bring the blended cost down substantially (example: dedicated blended $6/1M => ~$150/month for 25M tokens).

I’ve attached a filled-in estimate with both hosted and 12‑month committed Dedicated examples and the per-model line items. Short notes in the sheet: assumptions about average tokens per message, expected cache hit rates, and recommended model family choices (we recommended a mixed strategy: open LLM for embeddings + smaller tuned chat models for high-volume generation).

Next steps:
- Evan: confirm whether you want a hosted pilot or explore a small Dedicated commit (I recommend trying hosted for the pilot unless you expect immediate scale).
- Rishi: can you prepare a short SOW + an initial SLA addendum for procurement?

I’m available Tuesday or Wednesday next week for procurement + technical review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
